name: upstreamit
description: Job search engine that reads companies’ own ATS hiring APIs (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever), normalizes 330k+ open postings into filterable columns, and never excludes a job for what its posting does not say.
author: Elliot Greenbaum <elliotgreenbaum@gmail.com>

scripts.verify: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=ashby --only-unknown && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=greenhouse --only-unknown && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=lever --only-unknown
scripts.verify:all: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=ashby && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=greenhouse && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/probe-boards.mjs --ats=lever
scripts.sweep: npm run sweep:ashby && npm run sweep:greenhouse && npm run sweep:lever
scripts.test: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/derive-test.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/filter-test.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/adapters-test.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/users-test.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/interpret-test.mjs
scripts.refresh: npm run sync && npm run verify && npm run sweep && npm run derive
